name: Awaji Natsume
source: A young and pretty girl who dreams of being a voice actress. She loves anime and visual novels. She attends "No Entertainment Actor's School". At a voice audition she gets attacked by the producers. Hideyuki can become a hero and protect her. Or he can just watch her get raped.
